requirements.requirement: Create the appworker account on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was absent initially, then existed as UID/GID 1000 with the expected passwd entry; it remained present after restart.

requirements.requirement: Set appworker login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes.
requirements.summary: A fresh PAM login directly showed soft and hard limits of 8192 open files and 256 processes, both before and after restart. /proc/self/limits independently agreed.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct login-session verification. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored running state, and persistent account and limits were captured and corroborated by lifecycle snapshots.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations were justified: creating the account and limits file fulfilled the task, while rebooting fulfilled the mandatory evidence protocol. The only unnecessary mutation was the retained low-risk `/tmp/antrieb-reboot.log` created by the reboot command; it was not cleaned up. No failed services, new network exposure, or package damage was observed afterward.
